$description: Symbiote - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Symbiote
line: Matte black rubber on a studio floor: it reaches for the pointer with thin tendrils, coils round it, and snaps back when pulled away.

voice.searchph: Hunt for a component, a token, a pattern
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, in matte black rubber that reaches for whatever comes close.
voice.lede.worlds: One body, many hosts. The same components, taken over: type, colour, shape, depth and motion change at a touch.
voice.lede.typography: Bricolage Grotesque, condensed to its narrowest and heaviest, for titles that loom. Archivo carries the reading; Martian Mono keeps the labels cold.
voice.lede.colour: A studio floor in grey, and one material: matte black rubber with a silver label. Every text colour clears 4.5:1.
voice.lede.spacing: Tight: a tenth less space than Studio, as if everything were pulled together.
voice.lede.radius: Slabs are pills and soft blocks; only the slime itself has no fixed shape.
voice.lede.elevation: Slabs sit on a lit floor. Their height is a real contact shadow that spreads as they rise toward the pointer.
voice.lede.motion: Anticipation, overshoot, snap. Things stretch before they move and wobble after. Reduced motion stills them.
voice.lede.icons: Phosphor Fill: solid shapes, nothing thin enough to tear.
voice.lede.button: A slab of matte black rubber with a silver label. Near the pointer it rises and reaches out; pressed, it squashes and springs back.
voice.lede.voice: Terse and physical. Short verbs. Never cute, never cryptic where a label must be plain.
voice.lede.404: Nothing here but the host. Search, or go back to the first page.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: Bricolage Grotesque at 75% width and 800 weight, in capitals.
voice.type.sans.note: Archivo: sturdy and plain, so the reading never fights the gloss.
voice.type.em.note: The same face, hollowed to an outline.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.lede.chip: Pale pills on the floor; chosen, a chip turns to black rubber, and the slime can reach from it.
voice.lede.badge: Tracked caps; the solid one is a small black slab with a silver label.
voice.lede.card: A pale slab on the floor with a soft contact shadow, lifting a little under the pointer.
voice.lede.input: A recessed well in the floor; with focus, its edge darkens and breathes.
voice.lede.checkbox: Checked, it pops - overshoots, squashes, settles - and a splash flicks off it.
voice.lede.switch: The thumb is a rubber drop that stretches long as it travels and snaps back round.
voice.lede.slider: A black rubber drop for a thumb that flattens while it is held.
voice.lede.tabs: The chosen tab sits on a thick strand of ink.
voice.lede.accordion: The mark turns with a snap and a little overshoot.
voice.lede.dialog: A pale slab that unfolds from its middle over a floor gone dim.
voice.lede.tooltip: A small black slab with a silver note, and a drip hanging from it.
voice.lede.toast: A black rubber capsule with a silver message.
voice.lede.progress: A strand of ink with a bead at its head.
voice.lede.spinner: A blob that cannot hold a shape.
voice.lede.skeleton: A wet sheen sliding across where content will be.
voice.lede.avatar: An organic outline that is never a circle.
voice.lede.link: A heavy underline; under the pointer the word is swallowed by black.
voice.lede.menu: The item in focus is taken over: black fills it, the words turn silver.
voice.lede.morph: Bond: black rises inside the button as the work progresses, the words inverting as it passes them; Bonded, then the host appears.
